name: df
description: Disk free: for each mounted file system, shows its size, used space, available space, usage percentage and mount point. To find out what is taking up space in a directory, use du.

options.description: Sizes in readable units (K, M, G).
Adds the file system type (ext4, tmpfs, vfat…).
Shows inode usage instead of blocks: a disk can be “full” for lack of inodes.

example.output:
Filesystem     Inodes IUsed IFree IUse% Mounted on
/dev/sda2         15M  812K   14M    6% /

options.description: Shows only file systems of this type.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Shows only the file system that contains this path.

examples.explanation: Usage of every disk, in readable units.
examples.output:
Filesystem      Size  Used Avail Use% Mounted on
/dev/sda2       234G   98G  124G  45% /
/dev/sda1       511M  6.1M  505M   2% /boot/efi

examples.explanation: With the type of each file system, leaving out temporary in-memory ones.
